title: Authorization Hold Share for Storage Tenants of the Pickup Facility (Bluegate Moving Truck Rental)
content:
**Tenant hold terms.** The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental hold tenant share depends on the renter's storage agreements — the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records (status, facility, move-in date) and the late fee entries on the storage tenant ledger:

1. a renter whose active storage agreement at the pickup facility moved in **24** or more calendar months before and who was billed no storage late fee within the last twelve months takes **0.5** of the card deposit;
2. any other renter with an active storage agreement at the pickup facility takes **0.75**;
3. a renter without one keeps the card deposit as it is.

## Decision table

| Active storage agreement at the pickup facility | Moved in 24 or more calendar months before | Storage late fee billed within the last twelve months | Share of the card deposit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | 0.5 |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | 0.75 |
| Yes | No | No | 0.75 |
| Yes | No | Yes | 0.75 |
| No | — | — | As it is |

## Month boundary (hypothetical active agreement at the pickup facility, moved in 10 March 2024, no late fee in the last twelve months)

- Handled on 9 March 2026: 23 whole calendar months, so 0.75.
- Handled on 10 March 2026: 24 whole calendar months, so 0.5.
